title: Variant
description: A sellable colour/size combination of a product.

anyOf.description: Normalised GTIN-14. The consumer's match key.
GTIN exactly as the brand supplied it (e.g. 13-digit EAN).

sku.description: The brand's article/SKU number for this variant.

collection_id.description: Proposal 0006 (optional member): the id of the released collection of this variant's colour, or null.

size_length.description: Second size where one exists, e.g. the length of jeans (size 32, size_length 34) or the cup of a bra (size 75, size_length B).

size_system.description: Optional size system, e.g. EU, UK, US, INT, FR, IT.

language_fallbacks.description: Only present when the request selected a language (`lang` or `Accept-Language`, protocol.md §2.3): which localised fields of this object fell back to another language. Pointers into nested variants and assets are in their own objects.
